quest.title: An Expected Plan
quest.description: After a thorough investigation, the Fontaine Research Institute seems to have found a lead on Nacker and the Arkhium Kinetic Core. Now, all that's left is to bring him to justice.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: I've sent someone to give your report to the Institute. In any case, I shall leave the upcoming work to you, Ms. Fusilier.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Of course, Mr. Raimondo. But about the help you mentioned...

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Don't worry. When the right time comes, our Honorary Senior Researcher will...

choices.text: Appear by your side.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: It's great to see you so soon, Honorary Senior Researcher and the Assistant to the Honorary Senior Researcher. Oh, allow me to introduce...

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: This is the special investigator in charge of the stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core case, Miss Fusilier.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Before I ask for your help again, please allow me to briefly explain the case of the Arkhium Kinetic Core's theft.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: ...And some other key information.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Raimondo briefly explains why the Fontaine Research Institute initially identified Nacker as the prime suspect.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: An intense surge of Arkhium energy would have filled the Central Laboratory after the explosion, so only professionals could've engaged in work there for any length of time.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: And the timing of the Experimental Field Generator's activation and attack was too much of a coincidence. According to Raimondo, the suspect must be a senior researcher linked to the research, and subsequent examinations and reenactments of the events have borne this theory out...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The only people capable of this in Fontaine Research Institute are Raimondo, Nacker, and Edwin, the last of whom passed away during the explosion. Raimondo mentions that he too is under internal review... and it sounds like a huge pain...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: However, locating the Core as soon as possible still remains your main objective... The unstable prototype may go out of control at any moment and release a surge of Arkhium that would affect everything around it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Doesn't that mean it might explode again at any moment!?

choices.text: Ugh... Nacker...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! I—It seems we don't have a choice. Looks like Nacker really does deserve a good beating!

choices.text: He won't get off that easily if I have anything to say about it.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: I'll be counting on the two of you. I must return to the Institute.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Mr. Choiseul won't be able to deal with so many journalists for long on his own...

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Even if it's just for the sake of his health, I ask that you get to the bottom of this matter as soon as possible.

choices.text: I wish him good health.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Hahaha! I thank you on his behalf, then.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Raimondo leaves in a hurry...

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Honorary Senior Researcher, let's act quickly. The sooner we find the culprit, the sooner we can clear Mr. Edwin's name.

choices.text: Mr... Edwin?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Edwin has helped me in many ways. He was a... good person.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Nacker, on the other hand, is a despicable lowlife who used Mr. Edwin's research to harm the Institute for his own selfish interests! That's unforgivable!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: It is my belief that he framed Mr. Edwin for the initial explosion in the Institute too.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: After all, he is the only one who could have benefited from how things have played out up till now... and he has the Arkhium Kinetic Core.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: If Nacker is really alive, then I will definitely catch him. And then, I'll make him pay for what he's done.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: But I'm sure you're not here to discuss this, right, Honorary Senior Researcher?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: It's almost time. Let's head down to Lumidouce Harbor. I'll brief you on the specifics once we get there.

choices.text: You sound like you have a very good impression of him.
I'll buy you as much time as possible.
My responsibilities as an Honorary Senior Researcher are back to bite me again.
Ugh, I just hope it doesn't blow us all sky-high...
What trouble are you all planning to cause me now?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are we doing here? We look like eavesdroppers...

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Well, we are here to be eavesdroppers. But I think we have to wait a little longer... Let's get behind those shrubs for now.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You wait for some time behind in the shrubbery...

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Look over there. Those are the people we're waiting for.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: According to my investigation, they're reselling a batch of goods linked to the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: And this may be connected to Nacker... Let's get closer.

talks.objective: Stay quiet and listen for clues

dialogues.text: ...Boss! There's someone over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—We've been spotted!?

dialogues.speaker: Loillier
dialogues.text: Mr. Chaussivert, it seems you don't know the rules. I suppose that's as far as my warnings go. Farewell.
You pretentious... Let's go! Take those snoops out!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Fine... You're good. It's my loss.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: It doesn't matter who hired you to silence me. Just do as you please.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? No one's trying to silence you! Actually... We're hoping you'll talk.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: We're special investigators from Fontaine Research Institute. Mr. Chaussivert, we suspect that you're involved in the disappearance of our Arkhium Kinetic Core. Please cooperate with our investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: So the Institute seeks assistance in their investigation by hiding and eavesdropping? Why am I not surprised?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Th—That's just a necessary investigative technique. Allow me to explain...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Fusilier gives Chaussivert a detailed account of everything. He doesn't seem to fully understand her, however...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: I don't understand... Lemarcq, what the devil is all of this?

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: I think she's trying to tell you that some idiot stole something from the Institute, and that thing might explode at any moment.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: If it explodes near Lumidouce Harbor, it'll kill all the fish there and render it impassable to ships.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: So they're here to get that idiot. That's what you were trying to say, right?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Your summary is correct. I guess there is someone here with brain cells to rub together, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: I see... So you're here to do good, then. And here I was, thinking that that blasted Loillier had sent you to silence me.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Hmph! I misunderstood you. It's my mistake, so drinks are on me next time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Silence you? Weren't you discussing a business deal?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: A deal? Hahahaha! Looks like this misunderstanding's mutual... I would never do business with trash like Loillier.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: He's always with the Snezhnayans, and all he cares about is transporting Fontaine's goods to the outside for his own benefit. He's as bad as they get.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Some time ago, he came asking for my help in smuggling a person out of Fontaine on the down low.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To smuggle someone out? Could it be...!?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Yes, it could be Nacker, the one we're looking for. What happened next, Mr. Chaussivert?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Hmm. He looked to be up to no good, so I turned him down.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or do you seem a bit... disappointed, Miss Fusilier...?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Huh? What? I—I'm not! How could I possibly hope that someone might commit a crime? No way...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Today, he came all the way to threaten me, telling me not to leak out any information regarding this incident, or else his boss Concini would personally come to teach me a lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: I was just about to teach HIM a lesson when Lemarcq noticed you eavesdropping, and the guy seized the chance and fled... I guess I'll just have to wait until the next time he and I meet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So this Loillier's boss is called Concini...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Paimon's never heard of him. C—Could he be a Fatuus?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, never mind, Paimon's just joking! There's no way that everyone from Snezhnaya who we've met is a Fatuus... Hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: I used to think that way, too, but I really don't know what's going on with that Concini guy from Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: All I know is that he's a major buyer, and he's been purchasing all kinds of goods and equipment and sending them to the harbor. I have no idea what kind of business he's involved in.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: That said, since he's associating with the likes of Loillier, he's definitely no better.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Boss, this is not the place to talk. Let's head back to the ship first.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Right. You, come with me. You're looking for that "core" thing or whatever, right? I'll help you with it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh? What a surprise! And I thought there was gonna be a twist.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: You... You're not planning to kill us onboard and dump our bodies in the sea, are you?!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: This entire Lumidouce Harbor is under my protection. Anyone causing trouble around here is my business.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: If what you said is true, then I'm doing the right thing. If not, at least Lumidouce Harbor will avoid disaster. Don't you understand that at the very least?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Y—You have a point...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Enough chit-chat. You want to talk? Get on the ship and talk.

talks.objective: Follow Chaussivert back onto the ship

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Do you own the entire ship?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Of course it's mine. Now, let's get on with business. That thing might go off at any second, right? There's not a moment to lose.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: But... We don't have anything else to go on. Based on what we know so far, you run the largest underground trading operation in Lumidouce Harbor and often deal in items related to the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: During our investigations at the harbor, our investigators found trace amounts of Arkhium energy reactions on some goods. We believe that Nacker may have come through here with the core...

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: That's why we came to you, following the trade leads, but we didn't expect to find out that...

choices.text: You're not even involved in this kind of business.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Hmph! The gray market is not the same as the black market... I'm not a parasite like Loillier.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! You just said you're in the gray market. Get off your high horse!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: If you'd only came to me sooner... I'd have captured that Loillier guy! He said he's gonna teach me a lesson? That, I can't wait to see.

choices.text: You should've given us a chance to explain, at least!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're the one who charged at us without a word! We wanted to explain, but you didn't give us a chance to!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Bah! I said two sentences! What do you mean by "without a word"?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Loillier... Concini... I'll report their names to the Institute. But now...

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: Boss, sorry to intrude, but didn't Loillier say something like "there's no use for you now" earlier?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Hmph! That he did! That scoundrel even said that it's a shame how I missed out on a load of cash... I should've punched him in the face right there!

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: Could that mean... that he's already found someone to do his dirty work?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: You mean, someone has taken the job?

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: Yes, and that someone may have been paid already.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, if we can find out who just came across a sudden windfall...

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: As far as I know, Loillier prefers to hire poor and lazy slugs who sit around daydreaming...

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Because people like that are easiest to deceive and control, right?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Well, seems like you've seen your fair share. Perhaps there are also people like that in the Institute?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Mr. Edwin once said that if you live your life seriously, you'll find that people like that are all around you.

choices.text: Right, so no more naps whenever you want from now on, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You don't have to stress that!

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: No worries. I know who to see first... Boss, do you remember Covault?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Sure, I remember him. He used to be the most famous drunkard working under me, but I kicked him out of the outfit because of his habit of nicking this and that.

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: Well... He's now a regular at The Rusty Rudder. Pitot said that he's basically there all day, buying up most of the wine...

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: I think we should go and have a "conversation" with him.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Wait. But we don't have any proof...

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Proof? Hahaha, if Covault needs some, I'll find him some.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: But before that, he has to have an honest "conversation" with me.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Helm, plot a course to The Rusty Rudder!

choices.text: It's okay, Paimon. We're not rich, but we're not exactly broke either.
Don't worry, Paimon, we're no lazy slugs.
I should've come out and given all of you a beatdown.
Your mindset regarding trades is surprisingly narrow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, that's like saying "You lack creativity in your criminal activities"!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Hahaha! Well, I'm certainly not a parasite like Loillier.

talks.objective: Look for Covault at The Rusty Rudder

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: *cough* *cough* A person could choke on this alcoholic reek...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are so many drunks in here... Can we really find this Covault guy?

choices.text: Don't most people go home when they've had too much to drink?

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: With his financial state and moral standards, "home" is a luxury he can't afford.

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: He has nowhere else to be except the tavern.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Just to be on the safe side, let's stay together. The people in this watering hole aren't the friendliest.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Especially you, Institute lady. Don't stray too far from me. These drunkards might try to rob you, given how fragile you seem.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Then they will have the privilege of witnessing the power of our proud creations.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Mr. Edwin instructed me on how to modify this meka. The energy beam it emits can easily incapacitate a person.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Paimon and I will try our luck over there.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Alright, let's go. I'll take the lead. Lemarcq, you watch our flanks.

choices.text: Maybe he went to take a breather outside?

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: Then, we can only hope that he passed out somewhere in the wild and met his end.

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: In any case, let's at least be civil enough to go look for him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen a guy called Covault?

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Sure. He just bought another round for everyone before stumbling out the door.

dialogues.speaker: Pitot
dialogues.text: Humph... I wonder where he got all that money.

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: Heheh... I'm gonna be rich... How dare you belittle me... Burp.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: That's him. There's no one else in Lumidouce Harbor with a rat-face like that.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Covault! Get up!

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: Wh—Who are you? I'm in the money now... Don't... Don't you dare shout at me!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Oh, sure. So where did you get it? Details, if you please.

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: Y—You... Chaussivert!

dialogues.speaker: Covault
dialogues.text: You... It's all because I worked for you... that I missed out on making big money!

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: B—Boss! Chaussivert! Please forgive me, big man!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Forgive you? Well, that depends on your behavior.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Lemarcq, tie him up and take him back to the ship!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Sober yet, Covault? Can you speak properly now?

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: B—Boss! Chaussivert! I—I... Please forgive me... That was the alcohol talking...

choices.text: You want some more to help you relax?

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: You... You're right, right. Whatever you say!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: I ask you a question, you give me an answer. Anything more or less, I knock your teeth out. Clear?

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: Yes, yes! Crystal clear!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: First question. Were you hired by Loillier?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: On the count of three.

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: Yes, yes! He hired me to escort someone to a certain location in Lumidouce Harbor. I don't know who the person is. I just escorted him to the designated location, took the money, and got out of there!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Second question. This person you were escorting, was he carrying something?

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: Well, he had a large backpack on his back, and nobody was allowed to look at it... But... it was very strange. It was warm, and it kept on buzzing...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Could that be...?!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: It's the self-heating effect generated by bound Arkhium. Mr. Edwin's talked about it before. The backpack must contain the Arkhium Kinetic Core.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: And the person must be Nacker.

choices.text: Guess we've got our man.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's gonna give him a good bashing...

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Third question. Where did you escort him to? Give me the location.

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: B—Boss... could you give me a map? It's too remote a location to give that precisely...

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Sure. I'll get you a map. Don't try anything, or else.

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: I wouldn't dare... hehehe...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Covault nervously marks the location on the map...

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: Boss, there you go. That's the place.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: I assume that there won't be an ambush waiting for me? Or have you hired somebody to take me out?

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: I would never, boss! You know I won't lie!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Heh... Fine. When we get there, you take point.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Chart a course! That's where we'll be heading!

choices.text: Tsk. If only we could just blow it up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Haven't we had enough of that already?

choices.text: Alcohol steels the soul...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Wait. Now that we've gone far enough, what does your device say, Little Miss Institute?

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: No reaction... at all. There is no residual Arkhium energy here.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Strange. I've already tuned its sensitivity up to max, and Arkhium energy flow doesn't dissipate that easily...

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: This prototype was made by Mr. Edwin himself... There's no way it doesn't work...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? H—How come they... and those meka behind them...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: I knew it. Pattyn, how much did Loillier promise you?

dialogues.speaker: Pattyn
dialogues.text: An amount I'd never earn slaving under you in a lifetime. It's nothing personal, Chaussivert. But I have mouths to feed.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Don't you feel dirty getting mixed up with the likes of Loillier, taking his money like that?

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: Hehehe... Boss, we all roll in the same mud puddle. The money we earn? It's never clean.

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: You're the only one riding your high horse, saying "this business is no good, that business harms people," like you're some kinda saint.

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: In the end, you earn no money and win no people. Only a fool like Lemarcq would stay loyal to you.

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: We've sailed together for a long time. I'm sure Morgen will make his death painless.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No... Oh no! Mr. Lemarcq is still on the ship!

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Don't worry. He has the Pneumousia Ray Self-Defense Device, which was personally modified by Mr. Edwin himself. He'll be fine.

choices.text: You only just came up with that name, didn't you?

response.speaker: Pattyn
response.text: Hmph... Come on, Covault, hurry up and take care of them. Loillier's money is waiting for us to claim it.

response.speaker: Drunkard
response.text: Stop telling me what to do! You... Go on, get them!

choices.text: You really are confident in that device of yours.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: I'm just confident in Mr. Edwin!

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Please meet Miss Fusilier there as soon as possible. She will brief you on the latest information.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Don't mind me saying this, but the situation at Lumidouce Harbor is... delicate. Please be extra careful when handling matters there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... Those three are all in league with each other?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That Concini guy is like the owner of a restaurant, getting Loillier to find a chef to cook for Nacker...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: I told Loillier to beat it, so he went and found someone else to work for him... And then, he wanted to silence me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, it feels like someone who messed up trying to cover their own mistake.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Huh, I see! Well, that certainly does sound like the right amount of trashy for Loillier! You may be little, but you're quite brainy, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you can keep the first part of the sentence to yourself! Anyway, now we're sure that Nacker is in Lumidouce Harbor, and we've narrowed down the search area by quite a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (But things are never that simple, are they...)

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Ahem... Boss, we better interrogate them to see if they have any useful information.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Hm, good idea. Pattyn, you know the rules, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Pattyn
dialogues.text: ...I'm at your disposal, Mr. Chaussivert.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Good. At least you accept the consequences of your own actions. Lemarcq, tie him and Morgen up real good.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Go to your cabins and rest. And remember to put on some earplugs... Let's just say that this won't be a silent night.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After some contemplation, you decide to sit down and rest. In the middle of the night, you are awakened by strange muffled noises and the sound of something heavy falling into the water outside of your cabin. Did something or someone fall into the water? Should you go help? Wait. Chaussivert warned you that this will not be a silent night...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You walk to the door and grab the handle. The commotion outside has quieted down by now, and only the muffled sound of waves hesitantly lapping against the hull remains as you stand hesitantly before the door. What awaits outside? A question? An answer? Regardless, with just a twist of your wrist, you can verify... certain thoughts of yours, can't you?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You hesitate. Despite already having the answer, you still want to ask for Fusilier's opinion. You turn around and see how Fusilier is trying to cover her ears, pretending to be fast asleep.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: In the end, you suppress your and Paimon's curiosity and decide to not investigate. You just hope that this night will pass quickly...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: I hope you're well-rested. Pattyn and Morgen have told us everything.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: How? They were all bent on killing us not so long ago...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Well, that you don't need to know, Little Miss Institute. Lemarcq, tell them.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Aye, aye. To put it simply, with their cooperation, we have learned that two shipments will be delivered to a certain location today...

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, those two don't know the precise location. All they know is the time when the shipments will arrive at the shore.

choices.text: So, more guesswork on our part.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: I have an idea. We may be able to find some clues using this energy flow detector.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: If that place is indeed where Nacker is hiding, then people going in and out will carry traces of Arkhium energy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! That means that all we have to do is to use this device, and "beep beep beep" — we'll know exactly where to go!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: What do you mean, "beep beep beep"? Only those obsolete relics do that! I'm using the latest, silent model.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Beeping or not, this is a good shout. No time to waste. Let's move.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: About those two...

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: They've gone back to where all sailors come from. No need to worry about them... Anchors aweigh!

choices.text: Never mind. We'll see how it goes.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: We're almost there... It seems like the shipment hasn't arrived yet.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Let's wait here for a bit. Keep your ears sharp. They might show up any second.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Everyone finds a place to hide and waits for the couriers to arrive...

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Look over there! Are those the people we're waiting for?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Must be. They seem to be handing off the shipment... They'll definitely start transporting it soon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are we eavesdropping again? But this time, we're eavesdropping on the Treasure Hoarders...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is how the Institute does things.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: That's not true! Oh, s—sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Let's follow him. But be careful, don't get caught again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean "again"?
Wh—Who are you? What are you doing here!?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Tsk. You've found me. You've got a keen nose.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: We'll leave the thinking to you, Miss Institute Lady. You're the brains, and we're the brawn, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Huh...? Hey! Wait! What do you mean by that?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: #Lemarcq, {NICKNAME}, let's take them down!

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Loillier, blast him... He's already paid the bulk of the payment, but he can't afford the rest!?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Chill, man. We're all underdogs here. Don't blame the messenger.

choices.text: Boss, what should we do with him?

response.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
response.text: W—Wait! Stop! How much is Loillier paying you? I'll pay you the same amount!

response.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
response.text: Or, how about this: Let me live, and I'll take Loillier out and grab his money, and then we can split the cash?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: There's no need for any of that. I just have a few questions for it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Answer them to my satisfaction, you live — or your head will roll.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Roll!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Loillier hired you to get the shipments here — that's it? Did he say who they're for?

response.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
response.text: I... I don't know. All Loillier said was to leave the shipments here, and that someone else would come pick them up.

response.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
response.text: The previous two runs were exactly like that, just at different locations...

response.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
response.text: I once stayed behind to see who the buyer was, but they didn't show. Another group of people took the shipment and headed that way. I dared not linger any longer, so I took off.

response.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
response.text: So... are you satisfied?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Good enough. Get out of here. You'd better stay away from Loillier. He's up to no good.

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: Boss, should I follow him?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: No need. Let him go and cause some trouble for Loillier. So, he said that someone would come to pick the shipments up, hmm?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Institute Lady, it's time for you to get that device of yours beeping. We need to move.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Didn't I say that this is the latest model, and it doesn't beep?

choices.text: Ma'am, what should we do with him?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Wh—Why are you asking me? And, what's with the "ma'am"? I'm not part of this outfit!

choices.text: Paimon, you handle him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure! Heheh, just watch Paimon... Hmmm... How many strands of hair should she pull?

talks.objective: Search ahead for the shipment's delivery point
Continue searching for the shipment's delivery point
Look for clues around the house

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: The readings... are high. There are clear residual energy readings from all around this house...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nacker... Why would he go through all the trouble to build a house here?

choices.text: He must have strong nerves!

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: The lock on this door doesn't seem too sturdy. I think I can break it open. Stand back.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Hey, don't just bash the door in! It might be someone's home... You know, that got irradiated for some reason...

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: If that's the case, we'll compensate them. It's your investigation, so the money should come out of the Institute, naturally.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Huh!?
What are you doing in my house?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, you showed up, Nack—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, you're not Nacker... But you're wearing the Institute's uniform...
You're here to deliver the supplies, aren't you? Just leave the things at the back of the house. Can't you read the note on the door?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: You're...

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Mr... Edwin?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: How do you know me? Tsk... Did Loillier leak my name?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: No matter. Just hurry and get me the supplies. The suppressor will be ready soon... Hmm? Why are you staring at me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon must be seeing things from flying too fast...

choices.text: Well, well, well! Edwin Eastinghouse, come back to life, I see!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aren't you supposed to have died in the explosion at the Institute!?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Wh—What are you talking about? Stop wasting my time. I'm in a hurry to complete my research.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: I—I'm Fusilier from Section 3! You were my research advisor, and you helped me modify the Pneumousia Ray Self-Defense Device!

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: What Section 3? What Ray...? Oh, now I remember. You're talking about that highly inefficient radiation device, aren't you?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: What was the researcher's name, again... I can't remember. Whatever the case, that device was a solo project with no real practical value...

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: #Wait... You must be the Honorary Senior Researcher, {NICKNAME}. Your reputation precedes you...

choices.text: You know me?

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Hahaha! Concini told me about what you've done, and the title you've earned.

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: I have to say, the title suits you well! Just look at you, all hardworking and... Ahem.

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: But of course, I know full well why you're here, Honorary Senior Researcher...

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: You must be here for that Arkhium Kinetic Core, which that slippery fish, Nacker, stole...

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: I apologize, but despite his lack of creativity, pedestrian research skills, and how he's been constantly messing up my facility...

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: We're still in the same boat, so I cannot reveal his location to you...

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: I hear you, sir. However, I found this map in the house that marks a certain area...

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Gosh! How did you find this map... But no matter. His precise location won't be that easy to find.

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: You are welcome to go and look for him, but trust me, you could make five loops around the place, and you wouldn't find him. That place took us five full years to build!

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: I still remember that when that place was completed, I restarted five projects and rebuilt five devices. If I were still in the Institute, my salary would've quintupled...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #...So, what's happening now, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: He's monologuing...

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Lemarcq... stay here and keep an eye on this guy.

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Miss Institute... I mean, Miss Fusilier. This will be a dangerous trip, so why don't you give me the device? I'll handle things going forward.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: No. Let's get moving. I... I want to leave!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, she seems pretty upset. What happened? I thought she worshipped Edwin...?

choices.text: ...Let's catch up.

response.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
response.text: Good luck. You will never find him! Five rounds, you hear!?

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: If you keep this up for five more seconds, I'm gonna punch you five times.

choices.text: Edwin didn't even notice her.
Something must've triggered his inner Institute scientist.
Looks like you didn't quite get blown away far enough.
Oh no, the Institute is gonna get blown up again...
Or he took it from someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Self-Pitying Drunkard
dialogues.text: No... It's not my fault... I didn't want this... It's not me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Covault, you're in trouble!

dialogues.speaker: Self-Pitying Drunkard
dialogues.text: You... Oh. You're not here for me? Great... I didn't do anything wrong... Forgive me! I'm trying... I'll do better... *sobs*

dialogues.speaker: Restless Drunkard
dialogues.text: More... more! Who's drinking with me? You... You! You drink with me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Covault, cut it with the drinking!

dialogues.speaker: Restless Drunkard
dialogues.text: Who... Who? Never heard of him! You drink? You no drink? Whatever... I drink!

dialogues.speaker: Morgen
dialogues.text: ...What is it? Go do your thing.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: I've sent someone to give your report to the Institute. In any case, I shall leave the upcoming work to you, Ms. Fusilier.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Of course, Mr. Raimondo. But about the help you mentioned...

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: Don't worry. When the right time comes, our Honorary Senior Researcher will...

choices.text: Appear by your side.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: It's great to see you so soon, Honorary Senior Researcher and the Assistant to the Honorary Senior Researcher. Oh, allow me to introduce...

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: This is the special investigator in charge of the stolen Arkhium Kinetic Core case, Miss Fusilier.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: You are already aware of the circumstances of said case, so I won't be repeating them. In short, Mr. Nacker is the prime suspect right now.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Presently, we've discovered subtle clues in the Arkhium near Lumidouce Harbor, and... evidence that proves Mr. Nacker is still alive.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: If we follow these clues to the end, I'm certain that our suspicions about Mr. Nacker will be proven.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: But our main objective is still to retrieve the Arkhium Kinetic Core as soon as possible. It's an extremely unstable prototype.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: If our dear Mr. Nacker's practically empty head suddenly has the bright idea of attempting to modify said core...

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Maybe we'll get to enjoy another grand fireworks show somewhere...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—Wh—What!? Are you trying to say that it might explode!?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ugh... Nacker...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! I—It seems we don't have a choice. Looks like Nacker really does deserve a good beating!

choices.text: He won't get off that easily if I have anything to say about it.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: I'll be counting on the two of you. I must return to the Institute.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Mr. Choiseul won't be able to deal with so many journalists for long on his own...

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Even if it's just for the sake of his health, I ask that you get to the bottom of this matter as soon as possible.

choices.text: I wish him good health.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Hahaha! I thank you on his behalf, then.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Raimondo leaves in a hurry...

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Honorary Senior Researcher, let's act quickly. The sooner we find the culprit, the sooner we can clear Mr. Edwin's name.

choices.text: Mr... Edwin?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Edwin has helped me in many ways. He was a... good person.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Nacker, on the other hand, is a despicable lowlife who used Mr. Edwin's research to harm the Institute for his own selfish interests! That's unforgivable!

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: It is my belief that he framed Mr. Edwin for the initial explosion in the Institute too.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: After all, he is the only one who could have benefited from how things have played out up till now... and he has the Arkhium Kinetic Core.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: If Nacker is really alive, then I will definitely catch him. And then, I'll make him pay for what he's done.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: But I'm sure you're not here to discuss this, right, Honorary Senior Researcher?

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: It's almost time. Let's head down to Lumidouce Harbor. I'll brief you on the specifics once we get there.

choices.text: You sound like you have a very good impression of him.
I'll buy you as much time as possible.
My responsibilities as an Honorary Senior Researcher are back to bite me again.
What trouble are you all planning to cause me now?

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Why are you... You're back again. Told you. You can make five rounds of the place, and you still won't find him.

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: It's not working out for you, clearly, so why don't you just sit down and have some tea? I just bought five cups... and a few bowls.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: You really like the number "five," don't you, Mr. Edwin?

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Yes! It's a magical number! Use it right, and you can unlock the doors to endless inspiration!

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Listen up. There are five doors to endless inspiration, and you have to turn each handle five times... Five! You hear? Five times!

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Sorry, but I'm really trying to stop myself from punching you five times. Would you please kindly shut your trap?

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: We must resolve this quickly, Raimondo. I'm sure you're aware of the situation at the Institute right now.

dialogues.speaker: Raimondo
dialogues.text: If Miss Fusilier's information is reliable, then the rest won't be a problem. However, we'll need to get some help...

choices.text: Now, now, what evil are you two scheming this time?

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: Ah, Honorary Senior Researcher! It's so good to see you!

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: #I won't deny the truth of your words, {NICKNAME}. Still, I believe that you will make this "evil" into good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hoo boy, back to the world of meaningless, endless civilities, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just point to the point. You mentioned needing help... Are you planning to send us on errands again?

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: #Please come over here, {NICKNAME}. I have a document I wish to show you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A—Another explosion!? That tiny little core can explode too!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But according to this document... Nacker is alive, and... You've almost found him?

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: That is incorrect. It's still possible that Mr. Nacker has apologized for his deeds with his life.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: All I can say is that... our previous hypotheses are being confirmed, one after the other.

choices.text: I'm going to get that guy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! That liar caused so much trouble for everyone! And he thinks he can just walk away from it all!? Paimon's gonna give him a good bashing!

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Our special investigator stationed in Lumidouce Harbor, Miss Fusilier, will assist you. I will mark her location on your map later.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Please meet Miss Fusilier there as soon as possible. She will brief you on the latest information.

choices.text: Then I'll just wait here for Mr. Nacker to show himself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Getting some rest isn't a bad idea, hehe... We'll be counting on you, eh?

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: #That won't do. I'm afraid we still need your help, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Nacker has the core, and I can only imagine what kind of meka he will create to protect himself. You're the only one we can rely on to subdue him.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: And... Heh, don't you want to personally teach the man who has caused you so much trouble a lesson?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: My responsibilities increase with every passing day...

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: Heh, but your abilities must be growing steadily as well. I would expect nothing less from our Honorary Senior Researcher.

choices.text: Looks like my honorary titles are about to increase again, huh?

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: Oh, Honorary Senior Researcher! It's so good to see you.

response.speaker: Raimondo
response.text: #Perfect timing, {NICKNAME}. You do indeed have an extraordinary sense for such honors.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Hmm... This device sure is handy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Looks like Lemarcq just took care of that guy all by himself...

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: Boss, you're back. Looks like you were ambushed, too. That means...

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Loillier has bought both Pattyn and Morgen off. Covault was to lead us into an ambush.

choices.text: Sadly, they didn't expect me to be there.

response.speaker: Fusilier
response.text: Wait a second. If they were bought off by Loillier, then what about when you were talking to him...?

response.speaker: Chaussivert
response.text: Hmm. That can only mean that he had that meeting so he could eliminate me. Hmph. Brutal, but that sounds like him, alright.

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: Then I suppose it's a good thing that you lot came out of the blue to mess with their plans.

response.speaker: Lemarcq
response.text: Otherwise, given the narrow space... we might not have made it out alive.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, they've attacked us twice in a row now. Could they have something to hide?

choices.text: Just a motley crew.

dialogues.speaker: Cheerful Drunkard
dialogues.text: Drink up! More... Heheheh... Another Bulle Fruit... Put it... on my tab...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Covault, time to pay up!

dialogues.speaker: Cheerful Drunkard
dialogues.text: Who... Who's that? Who's... Covault!? Ah, move aside!

dialogues.speaker: Cheerful Drunkard
dialogues.text: Uh, no... I'm not Covault...

dialogues.speaker: Incoherent Drunkard
dialogues.text: Romaritime Flower... Romaritime... Flower... Heheheh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you saying, Covault?

dialogues.speaker: Incoherent Drunkard
dialogues.text: I... I'm talking to... the Romaritime Flower... Who's Covault?

dialogues.speaker: Incoherent Drunkard
dialogues.text: You... You're also Romaritime Flower? What a... coincidence! Hoohoohoo...

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Lumidouce Harbor... I remember that Doutey used to be in charge there. He seems to have found a way to be assigned elsewhere, though...

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: The person in charge right now should be Cassigneul... With a woman like her around, there's no way I'd ever do business in Lumidouce Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: You go with Chaussivert and try to find this guy. I'll stay here and guard the ship alongside Morgen.

dialogues.speaker: Lemarcq
dialogues.text: I even borrowed that device from the Institute Lady. The ship will be in good hands.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Covault...

dialogues.speaker: Lasselin
dialogues.text: Oh, him? I just saw him stumble out the door. Not sure which direction he was heading in, though...

dialogues.speaker: Lasselin
dialogues.text: I can't remember, but he's not in the tavern, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Covault...

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: That drunkard? He went outside to sober up. If you're here for some money he owes you, you're wasting your time.

dialogues.speaker: Permingeat
dialogues.text: Judging by how much he's had to drink... he's probably in a bush somewhere, trying to remember his own name.

dialogues.speaker: Morgen
dialogues.text: ...Looking for trouble, are you?

dialogues.speaker: Pattyn
dialogues.text: Hmph... A job that doesn't make you any Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No, that can't be it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What are we doing here? We look like eavesdroppers...

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Well, we are here to be eavesdroppers. But I think we have to wait a little longer... Let's get behind those shrubs for now.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: Look over there. Those are the people we're waiting for.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: According to my investigation, they're reselling a batch of goods linked to the Fontaine Research Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: And this may be connected to Nacker... Let's get closer.
...Proposal... Advice...
...Transport... Institute... Lesson...
...Scoundrels... Threatening me...
...Boss! There's someone over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—We've been spotted!?
Mr. Chaussivert, it seems you don't know the rules. I suppose that's as far as my warnings go. Farewell.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: You pretentious... Lemarcq, Morgen, Pattyn, let's get them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we know that Covault has left, but where is he?

dialogues.speaker: Drunkard
dialogues.text: B—Boss! Chaussivert! Please forgive me, big man!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Forgive you? Well, that depends on your behavior.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Lemarcq, tie him up and take him back to the ship!

dialogues.speaker: Covault
dialogues.text: Boss, we're close. We just need to head further in.

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: You think you can take me down by hiring a few Treasure Hoarders? You underestimate me, Covault.

dialogues.speaker: Covault
dialogues.text: Tsk... What's with you guys!? Go get him! Whoever takes him down gets double!

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: You... Stay away from me! Or I'm gonna hit you! This device is pretty sturdy, you know!

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: #Get behind me, Institute Lady! {NICKNAME}, let's clean up this trash!

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Someone snitched...! Who are you!? Who sent you!?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Loillier sends his regards. The shipment has been delivered, and you've outlived your usefulness.

dialogues.speaker: Panicked Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: Just to save the last bit of payment? That penny pincher!

dialogues.speaker: Fusilier
dialogues.text: The signals are getting stronger... We're close!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look over there! Am I mistaken or is that... a house?

dialogues.speaker: Chaussivert
dialogues.text: Smoke is coming out of its chimney. Someone's living in there. Stay sharp — I'll take point.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: With Chaussivert at the helm, the ship quickly arrives near The Rusty Rudder.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Restrained by Chaussivert, Covault is hauled back to the ship...
